claim: Château d'Aguilar in Tuchan is open March to November with summer hours 10:00-19:00 in July-August; adult tickets €4, children 6-15 €2.
quote: July-August: 10:00 AM-7:00 PM, May-June and September: 10:30 AM-5:30 PM, April and October: 11:00 AM-5:00 PM... Adults: €4, Children (aged 6 to 15): €2

claim: Walk from Aguilar's car park to the ruins is under 10 minutes on a short but steep, rocky path, accessible to less-mobile visitors.
quote: The walk is short (less than ten minutes) and fairly easy but you still need stout shoes... very easily accessible from the car park, so suitable for the less mobile traveller

claim: Château de Termes charges €6 adult / €3 child, with a €17 'Pass 3 sites' combining Termes, Villerouge-Termenès and Abbaye de Lagrasse; site is open daily April through All Saints'.
quote: The basic entrance ticket is €6 per adult and €3 per child... 'Pass 3 sites' option at €17 that provides discounted access to three partner sites: Abbaye de Lagrasse, Château de Termes, and Château de Villerouge-Termenès

claim: Termes requires a steep 10-minute ascent on stony paths from the village car park; visit takes about 90 minutes including a 15-minute introductory film on the Albigensian Crusade.
quote: A small ascent on foot (10 minutes quite steep) is required before arriving on the promontory and its castle... 15 minute film outlining its history during the Crusade against the Cathars... Expect to spend at least 90 minutes

claim: Château de Villerouge-Termenès opens weekends-only in March and Nov-mid Dec, daily 10:00-13:00 and 14:00-18:00 from April through October; adult ticket €6, child €2.
quote: In March, open only on weekends from 10am to 5pm... April, May, June, September, October: 10am-1pm and 2pm-6pm, non-stop on weekends... adults €6, children aged 6-15 €2

claim: Villerouge-Termenès is a fully restored four-towered castle in the village centre (no climb), with frescoes, a donjon viewpoint, lifelike-doll animations on Cathar history, and an on-site medieval rôtisserie restaurant.
quote: frescoes, beautiful wooden staircases, animations and lifelike dolls, with a recommended tour up into the Donjon offering astonishing views down over the rooftops of the village... The Medieval Rotisserie offers 3 different menus

claim: Château de Padern is a free, unstaffed ruin with steep paths reached by a marked walk from the village car park, but municipal decree advises against climbing inside due to falling-rock risk.
quote: the visit of the castle is not recommended by municipal decree because of the risk of falling rocks... Access is free and marked from the bottom of the village where you must leave your vehicle

claim: France's UNESCO nomination 'Royal Fortresses of Languedoc' (rebranded from 'Cathar Castles' at UNESCO's request) covers Aguilar, Termes, Quéribus and five others; ICOMOS recommendation expected Feb 2026, final World Heritage Committee decision in summer 2026.
quote: A recommendation is expected in February 2026, with the final decision due in summer 2026... One of UNESCO's conditions for recognition is that the popular term 'Cathar Castles' be abandoned... eight sites: the fortified city of Carcassonne and the castles of Aguilar, Termes, Lastours, Montségur, Peyrepertuse, Puilaurens, and Quéribus

claim: Driving distances from Fontjoncouse: Villerouge-Termenès ~14 km, Aguilar (Tuchan) ~18 km, Termes ~20 km, Padern ~23 km — all within 30 km radius.
quote: Château de Villerouge-Termenès: 14 km; Château d'Aguilar: 18 km; Château de Termes: 20 km; Château de Padern: 23 km

claim: Château de Quéribus (Cucugnan) charges €7.50-8 adult, is open year-round except 5-31 January and major holidays, with a steep ~10-minute climb from the free car park; ticket also covers the Achille Mir theatre.
quote: closed between January 5-31, opens 10h-16h30 in February-March and November-December... 9h-19h45 in July-August... adults cost €7.50 to €8... easily accessible path will bring you to the foot of the stairs in about 10 minutes

claim: Quéribus near Cucugnan lies roughly 45 km by road from Fontjoncouse — just outside the 30 km radius but a common pairing with Aguilar on a Cathar-castle day loop.
quote: The drive from Quéribus to Fontjoncouse is approximately 45 km
